    Description
    dev.tamboui.markdown
    Markdown rendering support for TamboUI.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    LinesChunk
    A chunk made of pre-wrapped lines.
    MarkdownInlineRenderer
    Renders the inline children of a markdown block node into a list of width-fitted Lines.
    MarkdownLayout
    Walks the markdown AST and produces an ordered list of RenderedChunks sized to fit a given content width.
    MarkdownParserHolder
    Lazily-initialized shared parser configured with GFM tables and task-list extensions.
    PartialMarkdownSanitizer
    Trims trailing partial markdown markers so a streaming source (for example one being typed token-by-token by an LLM) does not flicker as it grows.
    RenderedChunk
    A piece of rendered markdown that knows its own height for a given width and how to draw itself into a buffer at a target rectangle.
    WidgetChunk
    A chunk that delegates rendering to an existing Widget (for example a Block-wrapped Paragraph for fenced code blocks, or a Table for GFM tables).
